description: Database of the thermal power plant of OYOMABANG-CAMEROON (2016-2017-2018) is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. La difficulté majeure aujourd'hui est de connaître exactement la quantité de gaz à effet de serre (GES) générée par les centrales thermiques en utilisant une méthode et un modèle adaptés. Ces GES comprennent le dioxyde de carbone (CO 2 ), qui contribue efficacement à la destruction de l'environnement. Coverage: Cameroon. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are Atmosphere; TPO; Environment; Gaussian model; GHG; Inverse modelling; pdf. The repository dates the deposit 2022; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Restricted Access. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
